missable.reason: An unscheduled departure at VCIA is a one-off moment at the airport — do it when the chance comes, because there is no scheduled second one.
The Rhino tank moment is tied to a specific scene; once it passes, the tank is gone.
A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach reads as an early-game moment ('In The Beginning…') — take it before the story moves on.
Smashing out of a vehicle showroom is a scripted moment — it can only happen while you are in that showroom scene.
A story choice with consequences: the outcome depends on the choice you make, so check the guide before you choose.
Second time's the charm — this one turns on a retry of a moment, so it is easy to pass without noticing.
A strange one-time event: it happens when it happens, and there is no way to call it back.

note: Roadmap and missable flags built from the official trophy descriptions in app/data/trophies.json. The game is unreleased, so each missable flag is a warning drawn from what the description implies about timing; the full guides will confirm each one with a cited source.

stages.note: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission, and finish the story missions as they come. Story-completion trophies cannot be missed: the chapters always count. Watch the missable flags in this stage — seven trophies are tied to moments, choices or events that can pass you by, so read their guides before you play past them.
stages.title: Story first

stages.note: After the story, work through the activities: stunts, races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, meditation spots, hunting, bowling, and the stranger mission strands. None of these is missable — every activity can be replayed or retried in free roam.
stages.title: Side activities and strangers

stages.note: Sweep Leonida for the collectibles: card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicles to discover and register, garage properties, and the full map. Pair this with the challenge count and the gang operations. All of it stays available after the story.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.note: Finish whatever the 100% checklist still asks for, then the platinum is yours: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned.
stages.title: Cleanup and the platinum
